# Miles Cole

> > A technical blog focused on Microsoft Fabric, Spark, and modern data engineering with Python, Delta Lake, and lakehouse architectures.

Miles Cole shares in-depth technical articles and benchmarks on data analytics platforms, with particular emphasis on Microsoft Fabric, Apache Spark alternatives like Polars and DuckDB, and optimization techniques for lakehouse storage formats including Delta Lake, Iceberg, and Hudi.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft Fabric
- Apache Spark
- Delta Lake
- Polars
- DuckDB
- Data Engineering
- Lakehouse Architecture
- Performance Benchmarking
- Schema Inference
- Table Compaction
- V-Order Optimization
- Small File Problem
- Python Notebooks
- LakeBench
- Spark Job Definitions
